vision: Create an educational and analytical chess application that goes beyond standard chess apps by providing real-time visual feedback on board control, threat assessment, and positional strength for every square.

objectives.name: Playable Chess
objectives.description: Standard chess rules with legal move enforcement

objectives.name: Notation System
objectives.description: Real-time algebraic notation with FEN/PGN support

objectives.name: Threat Visualization
objectives.description: Real-time heatmap showing degree of control per square

objectives.name: Modular Architecture
objectives.description: Clean separation of concerns for maintainability

designPrinciples.name: Modularity
designPrinciples.description: Each feature as independent module with clear interfaces

designPrinciples.name: Separation of Concerns
designPrinciples.description: Game logic, UI, visualization, AI as distinct layers

designPrinciples.name: Progressive Enhancement
designPrinciples.description: Basic chess first, then layered features

designPrinciples.name: Machine-Readable Artifacts
designPrinciples.description: JSON configs, indexed resources, structured handoffs

phases.name: Project Foundation
phases.description: Establish project infrastructure, research documentation, and tracking systems

phases.name: Basic Chess Board
phases.description: Display interactive chessboard with piece rendering

phases.name: Legal Move Enforcement + Basic Notation
phases.description: Integrate chess.js for full rules compliance with real-time notation display

phases.name: Game Controls + Import/Export
phases.description: Full game management with save/load capabilities

phases.name: Game Library and Historical Games
phases.description: Access famous games and build personal game library

successCriteria: Fully playable chess with legal move enforcement
Real-time algebraic notation with FEN/PGN import/export
Real-time threat visualization with multiple modes
Working AI opponent at multiple difficulty levels
Game library with save/load and historical games access
Clean handoff capability at any point
